pages.title: CEEW study — 30 million cattle households do not sell milk

facts.text: Report: "Cattle and Community in a Changing Climate (2026)" — Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW), released 20 January 2026

facts.text: 38% of cattle rearers (~30 million households) do not sell milk; 31% rear mainly for household milk; ~5.6 million households fully non-dairy

facts.text: In 9 of 15 states, less than half cited milk sales as main motive

facts.head: News

facts.text: State: HP, Andhra Pradesh, Assam; Finding: over 15% cite socio-cultural reasons
facts.head: News

facts.text: 50% own just 1–2 animals; 82% own only one bovine type

facts.text: ~75% cite feed affordability; silage/ration-balancing adoption ~5%
